offering_description.value: Uniti sells broadband and phone service to households and small businesses, plus managed networking, communications and security services to enterprises and public agencies. It also operates fiber networks that provide wholesale transport and long-term fiber leases to carriers, internet providers and data center operators.

primary_services.value: broadband and phone service; managed enterprise networking and security; cloud communications; wholesale fiber transport; dark fiber leasing

customer_segment.value: B2C: Households buying internet and phone service; B2B: Small businesses, enterprises, telecom carriers, internet providers, cloud providers and data center operators; B2G: Government agencies and public school systems

end_markets.value: residential broadband; enterprise telecommunications; carrier networks; cloud and data centers; government and education

revenue_model.value: subscription: Monthly broadband, voice and managed communications plans; project or contract: Contracted enterprise connectivity, wholesale transport and custom fiber builds; rental or leasing: Long-term access to dark fiber and other network infrastructure
revenue_model.category: subscription; project or contract; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Builds and operates fiber networks serving households, businesses, carriers and data centers; service provider: Uses network capacity and software to deliver internet, voice and managed IT services to households, businesses and public agencies

geography_served.value: US national: Nationwide enterprise and wholesale networks, with residential service concentrated in rural and suburban markets across multiple states

specialization.value: related lines: Residential broadband, managed enterprise communications, wholesale transport and fiber infrastructure leasing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise and carrier account teams and residential phone sales; online: Residential broadband ordering through the provider website; partners / resellers: Telecom channel partners selling business connectivity and communications services

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Telecommunications operations subject to FCC carrier requirements and state utility commission oversight

notes: This profile covers the combined Uniti and Windstream group, and the operating scope of Uniti Group LLC itself is uncertain.
